Physical Hardware Sensor Relocation Protocol

CRITICAL HARDWARE STEP REQUIRED BEFORE REGISTERING NEW PLANT:

You are about to switch monitoring from {{plant.plant_name}} to a new plant. You MUST physically move your ESP32 sensors to ensure accurate telemetry and prevent false AI care diagnoses.

1
Extract Sensor Probes: Gently withdraw the capacitive soil moisture sensor and DS18B20 stainless steel probe from the current ({{plant.plant_name}}) pot.
2
Clean the Probes: Wipe probe tips dry with clean tissue to remove mineral buildup and cross-contaminating root microbes.
3
Insert in New Target Plant: Push both probes 3 to 4 inches deep into the soil of your new target plant near the root zone.
4
Verify ESP32 Power: Confirm the ESP32 board is securely powered and Wi-Fi indicator stays on.
